text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hah hah! To think someone as brilliant and prudent as myself would get injured!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It seems that the physics of the Earth weren't quite able to keep up with my Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Come on, Earth! Try to keep up next time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …All right! With this, it's perfect! Let's hurry and resume training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I'm a genius! Each one of my cells is extraordinary. Even if I get injured, I'll recover quickly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I'm a genius! Each one of my cells is extraordinary. Even if I get injured, I'll recover quickly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A bad idea?! Please be reasonable! I'm raring to go! And so is the earth beneath my feet!
…Despite being visibly dissatisfied, I somehow manage to convince her to take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! For some reason, the pain is getting worse?!
Her energetic movements cause her injury to get worse… I ask her to focus on recuperating.
Sakura Bakushin O runs energetically towards the training track.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Perfect, right? It seems the Earth also showed some regret.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This is the leadership power of a model student! The power of recovery!
Just as her mysterious theory predicted, she underwent a miraculous recovery… and became able to resume her training right away!
